name: Data Applications Company,Limited
summary: Data Applications Company, Limited, formed in 1982 with headquarters in Tokyo, Japan, develops, markets and consults on software in Japan for business-to-business EDI (electronic data interchange) and EAI (enterprise application integration). Its products include B2B servers for digital commercial transactions, foundational infrastructure for connecting enterprise data, no-code data exchange utilities and an EDI client for small and medium-sized enterprises.
